items.en: Ukraine says it struck the Staraya Russa aircraft repair plant that services Russia's A-50 radar aircraft
items.nl: Oekraïne meldt aanval op vliegtuigreparatiefabriek in Staraja Roessa die Russische A-50-radarvliegtuigen onderhoudt
items.sEn: Ukraine's defence forces struck the 123rd Aircraft Repair Plant in Staraya Russa, Novgorod Oblast, on the night of 9-10 November, according to Ukraine's General Staff as reported by Ukrainska Pravda.
